text:
Type: woven beige cotton throw
Use: covering a sofa, an armchair or a bed, keeping warm; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, farmhouse
Materials: chunky basket-weave cotton blend with a subtle sheen, hemmed edges
Colors: light beige, warm cream, greige
Shape: rectangular throw in two tones, a nubby textured weave, folds into soft thick layers
Feel: warm, natural, cozy, calm
Goes with: neutral linen, light wood, white walls, earthy tones; Scandinavian, farmhouse or Japandi rooms
